description: Unit test class for ImmutableAttributes in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package, testing immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and validation of attribute keys.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableAttributes, testing core aspects like immutability, JSON serialization, equality, and key validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ImmutableAttributes class is immutable and that JsonObject instances used are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that the ImmutableAttributes class correctly implements equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to the factory method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyAttributesIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an empty Attributes instance reports as empty.

methods.name: createImmutableAttributesOfImmutableAttributesReturnsNoNewObject
methods.description: Checks that wrapping an existing Attributes instance returns the same instance (no new object).

methods.name: toJsonReturnsSameAttributesObject
methods.description: Verifies that calling toJson on Attributes returns the same underlying JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonObject
methods.description: Tests creation of ImmutableAttributes from a predefined JsonObject.

methods.name: ensureAttributesJsonCorrectness
methods.description: Builds Attributes with several attributes and verifies the JSON matches the expected object.

methods.name: ensureAttributesNewBuilderWorks
methods.description: Verifies that Attributes can be built via a builder pattern and produce the expected object.

methods.name: ensureAttributesToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Checks that calling toBuilder on Attributes produces a builder that, when built, equals the original.

methods.name: createInvalidAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests that setting an invalid attribute key (with illegal characters) throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests invalid nested JSON objects with illegal key parts.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedNestedAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests invalid nested JSON objects within nested objects.

methods.name: createTooLargePropertyKey
methods.description: Tests that attribute keys exceeding maximum length throw JsonKeyInvalidException.
